venue.name: Monte Carlo Room
venue.details: The Monte Carlo Room on the back side of Sperino's Restaurant

items.information: Registration Fee: Any requested changes to registration before the deadline will be honored. Your registration is not complete until your name shows up on the list. If you believe you paid and your name isn't showing up, please contact us and we will work it out. If you have registered and are no longer able to attend, please contact us. If it is before March 3rd, you are eligible for a full refund of your fee on the condition that there is someone on the waitlist willing to take your spot. Attempting to file a chargeback for the registration fee will lead to being blacklisted from future WCA events. After March 11th you will only receive half of your registration fee for canceling. The registration fee will be $20 per competitor and there is a competitor limit of 150. Registration will open on Feb 7th at 12pm CST, and will close on March 11th, 2018 or when the competitor limit is reached. Competitors MUST register and pay online in order to compete. No at-the-door registrations or payments will be accepted. ALL SPECTATORS ARE WELCOME TO ATTEND FOR FREE. Guests have a $10 lunch fee. Paid with registration. There will be limited sign-ups for lunch the day of CASH ONLY, but the more that pay with registration the better. Day of is for unexpected guests only.

items.information: **All registrants are required to read the COMPETITOR INFORMATION tab**. Payment is needed to complete your registration and secure your slots for the competition. Check out the **Payment Details tab** for the process of payment. Registration fee is 300php good for 2 events (any event of your choice). 50php shall be added per extra event registered. Payment is needed before registrations via the WCA website is approved. Only the first 90 paid registrations will be accepted and allowed to compete on event day.
